stories.title: How American political campaigns are using AI – and what they’re spending on the tools
stories.summary: New campaign-finance disclosures show which US candidates, parties and committees are paying for artificial-intelligence tools and how much they spend. The reporting, linked to the book Rewiring Democracy, examines AI’s growing influence on American political campaigns despite politicians saying little publicly about their use of it.

stories.title: ‘Elon is my prophet’: how Musk’s Doge team took a wrecking ball to Washington
stories.summary: A Guardian account examines how young technologists in Elon Musk’s Department of Government Efficiency moved to disrupt US federal agencies. It focuses on resistance from one worker who sought to protect immigrant data after a February 22, 2025 email was sent across the federal workforce.

stories.title: Who’s your Uber driver on the phone to? Welcome to the long, long diaspora phone call
stories.summary: Long phone calls can help Uber drivers and others doing arduous, solitary work navigate the dislocations of immigrant life. The Guardian piece uses the familiar question of whom drivers are always speaking with to explore the role of extended diaspora conversations.
